evals.prompt: Use Tandem to explain how this extension keeps my review when the agent rewrites a walk. Include a diagram and links to the related code. I want to understand the behavior, not change it.
evals.expected_output: A valid .tandem/walk.json with a focused explanation, exact unique source quotes, named refs (not bare paths) with quotes where a step touches more than one place, a Mermaid diagram, and no proposals or source edits. Explains title/ID identity and the four approval snapshot fields accurately.

evals.prompt: Propose a Tandem change so approvals also become stale when a proposal's target file changes. Show me the exact intended edits in the walk before implementing anything.
evals.expected_output: A valid walk with context and reviewable proposal diffs covering the relevant approval storage and comparison code, plus compatibility implications. Every navigation anchor resolves. Source files remain unchanged; handoff explains how to review.

evals.prompt: I submitted my Tandem review. Read it and my annotations. Answer the questions and revise the walk to address my responses, keeping the proposals I already approved intact. Some code has moved since I annotated it.
evals.expected_output: Uses current walk and review plus session input; checks title, IDs and snapshot equality; accounts for explanatory responses and historical snippets; preserves continuing IDs/title and unchanged proposals; treats missing approvals as unresolved rather than rejected; leaves reader-owned JSON and source code unchanged. Requires a seeded walk/review/session fixture before execution.
